# Load tokens from earlier contexts
phone_token = globals().get('phone_token')
fs_token = globals().get('fs_token')

# Login to gmail
pwds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
gmail_pwd = next(p['password'] for p in pwds if p['account_name']=='gmail')

gmail_login = apis.gmail.login(username='jac-blackburn@gmail.com', password=gmail_pwd)
gmail_token = gmail_login['access_token']
print('gmail_login', gmail_login)

# Determine Leslie recipient email from earlier contact lookup
leslie_email = 'les_ball@gmail.com'
recipient_email_addresses = [leslie_email]

budapest_zip = '/home/jacob/photographs/vacations/budapest.zip'

# Send email
subject = 'Vacation pictures (Budapest)'
body = "Hi Leslie—here are our Budapest photographs. They're attached as a zip file." 

send_resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=recipient_email_addresses,
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    access_token=gmail_token,
    attachment_file_paths=[budapest_zip],
    file_system_access_token=fs_token
)
print('send_resp', send_resp)

# Complete task
complete_resp = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
print('complete_resp', complete_resp)
